title: locally-uncensored bundles private chat, media generation and coding
friendlyTitle: One desktop app runs several AI tools locally
summary: Locally Uncensored is a desktop AI studio that combines local language models, ComfyUI image and video generation, and a coding agent without requiring Docker or cloud services. The fast-moving AGPL project has about 1,300 stars and provides installers for local use.
friendlySummary: This project combines local chat, image and video creation, and a coding agent in one app. It can work without sending tasks to a cloud service.
whyItMatters: It offers a single place to experiment with private, offline AI workflows when hardware permits. Users should review model provenance, safeguards and the project's security notes before using less-restricted models or granting a coding agent access to important files.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It may help people keep work on their own computer. Use a safe test folder first and understand the risks of models with fewer restrictions.
